thread:
Mina Patel: FYI — noticed Wed 10:00am slot is double-booked: roadmap review (product) and a design review (eng). Can we resolve without creating two meetings? :calendar:
Carlos Rivera: Ugh, I booked the design review for that slot to keep the LA folks on. I can move if needed but prefer to keep it early Pacific.
Sophia Lin: We also have the triage call that's recurring at 10:30; moving the roadmap earlier would squeeze folks in EMEA.
Jae Kim: Quick question — which meeting can be async? The roadmap might survive as async notes + 10m sync, design review needs live screenshare.
Mina Patel: Good split. Proposal: keep live design review at 10:00, run a condensed 20m roadmap sync at 9:30 or asynchronous update + optional 10:45 open Qs. Thoughts?
Priya Nair: 9:30 clashes with our weekly all-hands prep for some PMs. Can we try async-first: roadmap doc + 15m optional sync at 10:45? That gives LA a chance to join after design.
Carlos Rivera: 10:45 feels late; engineers might be deep in context. If we do async, we need clear decision log and who signs off.
Mina Patel: Agreed. Let's use the decision-log pattern: one pager with 3 bullets (context, ask, acceptance criteria), then a 15m optional sync to ratify. I can host the doc.
product-ops-bot: Poll created: https://poll.redwoodops.com/p/2145678901 — options: (A) Live design @10:00 + async roadmap + 10:45 optional 15m; (B) Swap: live roadmap @10:00 + design @11:00; (C) Combine both into 40m joint session @10:00 with split agenda. React with :one: :two: :three: by EOD.
Sophia Lin: I'll vote :one:. Also volunteer to capture decisions if we go async.
Jae Kim: :one: from me as well. Can we have the doc template? I'll add a short prompt for triage items.
Mina Patel: Template (paste into the doc):
```
Title: Roadmap sync — week X
Owner: Mina Patel
Context: 1-2 lines
Ask: Approve priorities A/B/C
Acceptance criteria: What counts as 'approved'
Notes: links to designs, metrics
Decision: (to be filled)
```
Carlos Rivera: Fine with :one: — if any design issues spill into roadmap priorities, we'll escalate in the 15m.
Priya Nair: Cool. Who's the agenda owner for the 10:45 optional sync if it happens?
Mina Patel: I'll own the roadmap doc and run 10:45 if needed. Sophia will take decisions capture. Carlos, please confirm the design review stays at 10:00 and Jae will handle tech constraints if they come up.
Carlos Rivera: Confirmed — design review remains 10:00 in #eng-design. I'll post the short agenda and link to my deck.
Jae Kim: I'll be on standby at 10:00 for any infra/latency questions.
product-ops-bot: Reminder set: doc due 10:00am Wed. Mina please mark the doc link here when ready.
Mina Patel: Doc link: https://docs.redwood.com/d/roadmap-weekX — added ask + ACs. Folks, please add comments by Tue 5pm. :thumbsup:
Sophia Lin: Added decision capture section. If no objections by Tue 5pm, we'll run the 10:45 quick sync to finalise. Thanks everyone.
Carlos Rivera: Thanks — will review slides and keep design on schedule. :white_check_mark:
Mina Patel: Closing loop — plan: design review stays at 10:00; roadmap async with optional 10:45 quick ratify. Decision log + owner assigned.
